fusions.name: Elder Cousin's Jaw
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. A bite that deals 24 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Riverbank Roll
fusions.desc: Rolls your whole body through everything near you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Log in the Shallows
fusions.desc: After holding still for 1.5 seconds, your damage rises by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: The Slow Close
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.
